meta.title: Invite a vendor by entering details manually

args.goal: In the currently open Invite Vendor drawer, select "Enter details manually"; verify the Company Name, Address, and City fields are shown and required; enter valid Company Name and Address values, choose a valid City from the dropdown, click Next, review the summary, click Invite, and stop when the invitation success message is shown

steps.note: The manual invite drawer and its form-specific controls are not represented by a domain step, so this performs the complete buyer-side flow in the existing setup.
Confirms that the completed manual invitation was sent successfully.
